analysis_trace: Trial NCT07272109 is a Phase 3 randomized parallel-group study comparing active anti-diabetic treatment plus chemotherapy (nab-paclitaxel + gemcitabine) versus regular anti-diabetic treatment plus same chemotherapy in metastatic pancreatic cancer patients with diabetes (Type 3c). Primary endpoint is OS at 2 months; secondary endpoints include PFS at 2 months, fasting blood glucose changes at 1 month, and HbA1c control rate at 1 month.

Evidence base: No direct results available for this specific trial (NOT_YET_RECRUITING, primary completion Dec 2027). Retrieved evidence includes: (1) nab-paclitaxel + gemcitabine standard of care for metastatic pancreatic cancer with median OS ~8-11 months from MPACT trial; (2) metformin and diabetes management in pancreatic cancer shows mixed results - observational studies suggest HR 0.78 for OS benefit but RCTs (including phase 2 metformin + gemcitabine/erlotinib) showed no significant survival improvement; (3) active diabetes management improves glycemic control but survival impact in pancreatic cancer remains uncertain.

primary-0 (OS): Standard nab-paclitaxel/gemcitabine provides median OS ~8-11 months. Active diabetes management may improve metabolic control but RCT evidence for survival benefit is weak. Predicted median OS ~8.5 months for both arms with possible small benefit (HR ~0.85-0.90) for active management, but high uncertainty given lack of phase 3 data. Direction: higher_is_better.
secondary-0 (PFS): Standard regimen PFS ~5-6 months. Similar considerations as OS. Predicted median PFS ~5.5 months. Direction: higher_is_better.

secondary-1 (Blood Glucose Control): Active management expected to significantly improve fasting glucose vs regular care. Mechanistically supported by intensive monitoring and treatment titration. Predicted mean reduction ~30-50 mg/dL greater in active arm. Direction: lower_is_better (improved control).
secondary-2 (HbA1c Control Rate): Active management expected to achieve better HbA1c control. Predicted ~15-25% absolute improvement in control rate. Direction: higher_is_better.
Key uncertainties: No direct trial results; trial not yet recruiting; diabetes management intensity effect on cancer survival unproven in phase 3; Type 3c diabetes specific data limited.

Evidence roles: nab-paclitaxel/gemcitabine OS/PFS data = indirect_direction (different population, no diabetes focus); metformin pancreatic cancer RCTs = indirect_direction (different regimen, mixed results); diabetes management glycemic control = mechanism_background for glucose/HbA1c endpoints.
Safety: Standard chemotherapy toxicities expected; hypoglycemia risk higher with active management.
